claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Cognizant established a dedicated Gemini Enterprise practice with Google Cloud to accelerate enterprise adoption of Gemini Enterprise at scale.
claims.quote: Cognizant announced the establishment of a dedicated Gemini Enterprise Practice, in collaboration with Google Cloud, to accelerate enterprise adoption of Gemini Enterprise at scale.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Under the program, Cognizant plans to provide forward-deployed engineers who are senior engineering talent embedded directly in client environments and work with Google Cloud teams.
claims.quote: Under the program, Cognizant plans to provide forward-deployed engineers, senior engineering talent embedded directly within client environments, working in close collaboration with Google Cloud’s teams to accelerate time to value on Gemini Enterprise deployments.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Google Cloud designated Cognizant as a Diamond partner, the highest tier in its partner program, citing Cognizant’s AI Builder approach and production AI track record.
claims.quote: Cognizant has also been designated by Google Cloud as a Diamond partner, the highest tier in the Google Cloud partner program, in recognition of its AI Builder approach, combining engineering depth, industry expertise and a proven track record of operationalizing AI in production environments.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Cognizant is investing directly in Gemini Enterprise certification and skilling across its global delivery teams to build technical depth at scale.
claims.quote: Cognizant is investing directly in Gemini Enterprise certification and skilling across its global delivery teams, building the technical depth to deliver at scale.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: A Cognizant executive said the company has built and proven its forward-deployed engineer capability internally and is accelerating it to joint clients at scale.
claims.quote: Forward-deployed engineers working directly alongside Google Cloud’s teams, solving real problems in production, on site. We have built this capability, proven it internally and are now accelerating how we bring it to joint clients at scale.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: In an initial telecom engagement, Cognizant deployed AI agents targeting billing discrepancies across hundreds of millions in revenue, and the engagement surfaced more than a dozen additional Gemini Enterprise use cases.
claims.quote: A leading North American telecommunications provider engaged Cognizant to deploy AI-powered agents targeting billing discrepancies across hundreds of millions in revenue – an initial engagement that has surfaced more than a dozen additional Gemini Enterprise use cases across the client’s operations, spanning revenue recovery, invoice reconciliation and workflow automation.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: The Agentic Employee Platform can automate up to 60-70 percent of manual effort within targeted workflows and compress deployment timelines from quarters to weeks.
claims.quote: Operating under a human-led, agent-operated model, the platform can automate up to 60-70 percent of manual effort within targeted workflows, compressing deployment timelines from quarters to weeks.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: A Google Cloud executive said scaling AI into production requires an enterprise-ready platform plus partners that engineer targeted outcomes directly in the field.
claims.quote: Scaling AI into production requires an enterprise-ready platform combined with partners who can engineer targeted outcomes directly in the field," said Kevin Ichhpurani, President, Global Partner Ecosystem at Google Cloud.
